import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long best_num = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long best_den = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long best_err = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            long a = Math.max(x * b / y - 10, 0L);
            for (long j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
                long num = a + j;
                long err = Math.abs(x * b - num * y);
                if (best_err * b > err * best_den) {
                    best_err = err;
                    best_num = num;
                    best_den = b;
                } else if (best_err * b == err * best_den) {
                    if (best_den > b || (best_den == b && best_num > num)) {
                        best_err = err;
                        best_num = num;
                        best_den = b;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
        sc.close();
    }
}
